messages:
Lena Park: quick non-work drop — Tofu the capybara insisted on a proper bath today. pic incoming <https://i.imgur.com/TofuTub.jpg>
Tomás: 😭😭 so majestic
Maya: wait we have a CAPYBARA? need backstory pls
Lena Park: rescued from a small farm, fostered for a month, now permanently ours. he LOVES shallow warm water and will sit like a tiny king on a floaty
Tomás: that face is 10/10 regal sploosh :crown::sweat_drops: the cucumber dunk will be a historic moment
Maya: someone start a Tofu fan club, i'm in
ben-bot: Heads up — pinned this to #pets-highlights for 24h. :robot_face: (automated)
Lena Park: quick video coming where he gently steals a cucumber slice mid-dunk (i recorded it in portrait, sorry)
Tomás: ambient office requirement: weekly Tofu content. marking my calendar
Maya: also wondering if capybaras are kitten friendly? asking for a friend
Lena Park: he's surprisingly chill with cats — Lucy (our cat) did a sniff test, then became his PR manager
Tomás: PR manager Lucy, love it
Maya: drop his wishlist pls, maybe send a plushie. i volunteer to knit a tiny robe
Lena Park: will DM wishlist. for now: enjoy this laundry-judging stare: <https://files.redwood.com/tofu_laundry.jpg>
Tomás: that look could end wars
Maya: officially sold, sending knit robe pattern ideas. :yarn:
Lena Park: ok i'll accept robes and cucumber sponsorships
ben-bot: Note: channel topic updated to include 'Tofu Tuesdays' (temporary).
